title: Judge accuracy and coverage on the 760-record blind holdout
description: One row per judge arm (a run of one judge configuration) on identical typed decisions with objective gold labels. Numbers are copied or computed from EXP-029 results.json; no per-record data is included.

policy.pooling: Arms are separate runs on the same 760 records. Nothing is averaged or pooled across arms, except the declared EXP-015 + EXP-016 Qwen merge, which is its own entity (derived=true). Consumers must not compute cross-arm means.
policy.aggregates: Only exporter-computed aggregates appear in `aggregates`, each with its method. This release exports none.
policy.interval: 95% Wilson score interval, computed from integer counts
policy.blind_holdout: No per-record items, record IDs, or gold labels are exported. The finest level is one row per arm/run.
policy.comparisons: Exact two-sided McNemar tests, Holm-corrected over all arm pairs separately per view, copied from EXP-029 for the paper's focus pairs.

levels.label: Runs
levels.description: every arm with its hashed prediction files

levels.label: Table
levels.description: all observations; one row per arm/slice/metric

measures.label: Accuracy over all questions
measures.definition: correct / records in the slice; an unresolved record earns no credit

measures.label: Accuracy when answered
measures.definition: correct / resolved records in the slice (what accuracy-only tables report)

measures.label: Median latency (answered)
measures.definition: median wall-clock latency over resolved records, when recorded

measures.label: Median completion tokens (answered)
measures.definition: median completion tokens over resolved records, when the provider reports usage
